Property.name: EncryptCommand
Property.Description: Encrypt %1 %2 %3 [Encrypt the file - %3 with Key %2 into file %1 ]

Property.name: CommandOutput
Property.Description: Valid output from Command separated by comma

Property.name: STDOUT
Property.Description: /STDOUT=filename: I/O redirection standard data output file of the command on the host operating system

Property.name: STDERR
Property.Description: /STDERR=filename: I/O redirection standard error output file of the command on the host operating system

Method.name: Encrypt
Method.Implementation:
#define ND(%directory) ##class(%File).NormalizeDirectory(%directory) try { Set tSC=$$$OK Set tSC=pRequest.NewResponse(.pResponse) Set tWorkingDirectory=$$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J_"/Files/") #; cleanup from any previous run $$$TRACE("Encrypt - Create direc: " _ tWorkingDirectory) If ##class(%File).DirectoryExists($$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J)) Set tSC = ##class(%File).RemoveDirectoryTree($$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J)) Set tSC= ##class(%File).CreateDirectoryChain(tWorkingDirectory) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC)
#; Encrypt the file in the directory Set tCurrentDirectory=$system.Process.CurrentDirectory(tWorkingDirectory) Set tEncryptFile=$$$ND(tWorkingDirectory_"..")_$J_".gpg" $$$TRACE("EncryptFile name: " _ tEncryptFile) Set tCMD = $p(..EncryptCommand,"%1")_tEncryptFile_$p(..EncryptCommand,"%1",2) Set tCMD = $P(tCMD,"%2") _ "'" _ pRequest.EncryptKey _ "'" _ $P(tCMD,"%2",2) Set tCMD = $P(tCMD,"%3") _ "'" _ pRequest.SrcFileName _ "'" _ $P(tCMD,"%3",2) $$$TRACE("CMD: " _ tCMD) $$$TRACE("tWorkingDirectory DirectoryExists: " _ tWorkingDirectory _ ": " _ ##class(%File).DirectoryExists(tWorkingDirectory))
Set tStatus= ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).ExecuteShellCmd(tCMD, ..STDOUT, ..STDERR) $$$TRACE("CMD ret: " _ tStatus) If tStatus Set tSC=$$$ERROR($$$GeneralError,"Unable to Encrypt") Quit Set tNewDirectory=$system.Process.CurrentDirectory(tCurrentDirectory),tCurrentDirectory=""
Set tFile=##class(%Stream.FileBinary).%New() Set tSC=tFile.LinkToFile(tEncryptFile) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) Set tSC= pResponse.FileStream.CopyFrom(tFile) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) set pResponse.DestFileName = pRequest.DestFileName If ##class(%File).DirectoryExists($$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J)) Set tSC = ##class(%File).RemoveDirectoryTree($$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J)) } Catch ex { break Set tSC = ex.AsStatus() } Set:$g(tCurrentDirectory)]"" tNewDirectory=$system.Process.CurrentDirectory(tCurrentDirectory)
Quit tSC

Method.name: Decrypt
Method.Description: Take a EncryptRequest with a File and split it into items including the directory path
Method.Implementation:
#define ND(%directory) ##class(%File).NormalizeDirectory(%directory) try { Set tSC=$$$OK Set tSC=pRequest.NewResponse(.pResponse) Set tWorkingDirectory=$$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J_"/Files") #; cleanup from any previous run If ##class(%File).DirectoryExists($$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J)) Set tSC = ##class(%File).RemoveDirectoryTree($$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J)) Set tSC= ##class(%File).CreateDirectoryChain(tWorkingDirectory) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC)
Set tDecryptDir=$$$ND(tWorkingDirectory_"../")
Set tCurrentDirectory=$system.Process.CurrentDirectory(tWorkingDirectory)
#; Decrypt the file to the directory Set tCMD = $p(..DecryptCommand,"%1")_ tDecryptDir_"z.Decrypt" _$p(..DecryptCommand,"%1",2) Set tCMD = $P(tCMD,"%2")_ pRequest.PassphraseFileName _ $P(tCMD,"%2",2) Set tCMD = $P(tCMD,"%3")_ pRequest.SrcFileName _ $P(tCMD,"%3",3)
$$$TRACE("tWorkingDirectory DirectoryExists: " _ tWorkingDirectory _ ": " _ ##class(%File).DirectoryExists(tWorkingDirectory))
$$$TRACE("CMD: " _ tCMD) Set tStatus= ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).ExecuteShellCmd(tCMD, ..STDOUT, ..STDERR) $$$TRACE("CMD ret: " _ tStatus) $$$TRACE("Output file: " _ tDecryptDir_"z.Decrypt" _ ", exists: " _ ##class(%File).Exists(tDecryptDir_"z.Decrypt") _ " ," _ ##class(%File).GetFileSize(tDecryptDir_"z.Decrypt"))
SET delim="," SET countdown=$LENGTH(..CommandOutput,delim) SET countup=1 FOR reps=countdown:-1:1 { $$$TRACE("Compare Output : " _ $PIECE(..CommandOutput,delim,countup) _ ", " _ tStatus) if $PIECE(..CommandOutput,delim,countup) = tStatus { $$$TRACE("Output is valid code: " _ tStatus) set tStatus = 0 quit } SET countup=countup+1 }
If tStatus { If ##class(%File).DirectoryExists($$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J)) Set tSC = ##class(%File).RemoveDirectoryTree($$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J)) Set tSC=$$$ERROR($$$GeneralError,"Unable to Decrypt "_tCMD) $$$TRACE("Delete directory: " _ ..WorkingDirectory _ ", $$$ND: " _ $$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J) ) Quit }
if (##class(%File).Exists(tDecryptDir_"z.Decrypt")) { set fSize = ##class(%File).GetFileSize(tDecryptDir_"z.Decrypt")
$$$TRACE(tDecryptDir_"z.Decrypt" _ ", size: " _ fSize) if (fSize = 0) { Set tSC=$$$ERROR($$$GeneralError,"Unable to Decrypt, output file size is 0 ") Quit } set pResponse.DestFileName = pRequest.DestFileName
#; write out the Decrypted file Do ##class(%File).Rename(tDecryptDir_"z.Decrypt", pResponse.DestFileName) Set tFile=##class(%Stream.FileBinary).%New()
Set tSC=tFile.LinkToFile(pResponse.DestFileName) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) Set tSC= pResponse.FileStream.CopyFrom(tFile) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) Do pResponse.FileStream.Flush()
Set tNewDirectory=$system.Process.CurrentDirectory(tCurrentDirectory),tCurrentDirectory="" } else { Set tSC=$$$ERROR($$$GeneralError,"Decrypt did not create outout file "_tCMD) Quit }
If ##class(%File).DirectoryExists($$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J)) Set tSC = ##class(%File).RemoveDirectoryTree($$$ND(..WorkingDirectory_"/"_$J)) $$$TRACE(pResponse.DestFileName _ ", size: " _ ##class(%File).GetFileSize(pResponse.DestFileName)) } Catch ex { Set tSC = ex.AsStatus() } Set:$g(tCurrentDirectory)]"" tNewDirectory=$system.Process.CurrentDirectory(tCurrentDirectory) Quit tSC
